transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi. Um... I guess I'm just here because... I'm having a lot of trouble keeping track of things. Just, like, basic adult stuff. 

I keep forgetting to pay my bills, or... returning emails for job interviews. Missing appointments and not finishing errands. It's just... it's starting to cost me real opportunities, so... yeah. I figured I should come in.
Did you have these kinds of trouble with keeping track of things when you were a child?

Um... yeah, I guess so. Even back in elementary school... my teachers always wrote that I was bright, but... I don't know. I was always losing my worksheets. And my desk was just... so messy I could never find my assignments. Um... they also said I rushed through directions a lot, and... talked out of turn. So, yeah.
Do you often have trouble focusing on what someone is saying to you, even when you’re trying to pay attention?
Um... I don't really think so. I mean, I usually hear what people are saying. I haven't really... noticed that being a problem.
Do you often feel restless, like it’s hard to sit still?

Yeah, um... I do. It's kind of... always there. Like, if I have to sit through an interview or... a meeting, or even just watch a movie, I get this... pressure. Inside. Like I just really need to get up, or shift around, or... do something with my hands. If I don't, I just feel like I'm gonna... I don't know, crawl out of my skin.
Do these problems happen in more than one part of your life, like both at work and at home?

Um... yeah. I guess it's... everywhere. I mean, I'm actually unemployed right now. I... got fired. And since then, I've been missing the follow-ups for other interviews, so... yeah. I also had to step back from this volunteer project I really cared about. I just... I don't know. I feel like I can't reliably manage the basic steps to just... move my life forward right now.
Do you often feel excessively worried, even when there isn’t an immediate problem to deal with?
Um... no. I don't think so. I don't really... worry about things unless there's an actual reason to. So, no.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most days?
Um... no. Not really. Just... frustrated sometimes, I guess. But not depressed.
